faq.s: Explore answers about TSELEC's technology and services.
faq.q0: What kind of company is TSELEC?
faq.a0: Founded in 1989, TSELEC began with microcontroller design and manufacturing. Today we provide core control systems and automation solutions for home appliance, industrial, medical, and renewable energy sectors.
faq.q1: What are the main products and solutions?
faq.a1: Our main products include Embedded Controllers (MC series), HMI solutions (LCD/LED/OLED/TFT), and specialized control boards for 4 business areas. We also support custom turnkey control system development.
faq.q2: Can we request custom control system development?
faq.a2: Yes — leveraging 36 years of accumulated design know-how, we deliver custom turnkey solutions that perfectly match customer requirements.
faq.q3: What is the after-sales and technical support process?
faq.a3: Call our main line 032-329-7600 and our engineers will analyze the issue and provide solutions promptly.
